fusions.name: Towline Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow trailing a line that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hauls you up to 7 tiles along the line to the target.

fusions.name: Cobweb Barrage
fusions.desc: After a 0.6 second cast, looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, with a strand strung between them. Each arrow deals 12 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves its target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. [Slowed] is catching: it passes along the strand to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Second String
fusions.desc: Fits the spare string: clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Settled Sights
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
